services.value: Provides whole effluent toxicity (WET) testing and evaluation services for NPDES permits, including acute and chronic tests for NPDES discharge permits. Also offers toxicity identification evaluations (TIE's), toxicity reduction evaluations (TRE's), chemical product testing, effluent/wastewater toxicity testing, reverse osmosis reject water toxicity testing, ion imbalance studies, and consulting on toxicity issues.
